result.scope: Real settings IPC with five isolated held native-directory responses, sanitized failure, cancellation and untrusted-frame rejection; held atomic-save EIO, real Git creation with source preservation, gzip backup/restore and normal restart; six native zoom/theme cases with fixed test display scale. Root is an explicit existing directory; blank retains manual path entry. Automatic deletion, upstream fetching, snapshots, complete reference parity and physical system picker interaction remain separate.

scope: All fourteen selected originals individually viewed. Long paths scroll within the input; the ninth navigation category requires vertical scrolling at 150%. Native directory dialog responses are isolated fixtures through the real owned main IPC; physical Windows picker operation, full unit/source and current distribution remain separate. No claim of complete reference UI parity.
sourceState: Feature edits atop the recorded base, preserved in the immutable archive before the product commit.
sharedModalFix: Actual repeated Escape produced a noncancelable cancel event with closedBy:closerequest while busy. Shared Modal now sets closedby:none while dismissal is disabled; held directory and save fixtures press Escape three times, and idle dismissal still passes.

typeCheck.cause: Vitest array rows were interpreted as positional arguments instead of a single directory list. Object rows corrected the test signature; no production change was needed.

nativeFocus.observation: The first canceled picker response did not satisfy the enabled-input focus assertion before the unchanged ten-second bridge deadline. The exact underlying scheduling cause was not proven by the initial diagnostics.
nativeFocus.change: Restore input focus after the React busy-state commit instead of scheduling it independently with requestAnimationFrame. Revalidation remains required.

repeatedEscape.observedCause: The final diagnostic recorded a native dialog cancel event with cancelable:false and closedBy:closerequest while the header remained disabled. preventDefault could not block this event, and the native dialog closed. Earlier diagnostics did not record cancelable, so their exact cause remains bounded to the observed dialog closure.
repeatedEscape.change: Shared Modal explicitly sets closedby:none while dismissal is disabled and restores closerequest when idle. Actual native picker and save fixtures press Escape three times while held. All original deadlines remain unchanged.
